title: First Data Premium Gift Card Magnetic Stripe Data Layout
applicability: Applies only when Segment 100 transaction context uses the First Data Premium Gift Card magnetic-stripe flow.

businessRequirements.title: Premium Gift Card Track II data shall contain a 16-digit Account Number using the assigned Premium Gift Card BIN structure.
Premium Gift Card Track II data shall preserve the source-defined separator, YYMM expiration, service code, PVV, discretionary data, and integrity characters.
Premium Gift Card serial-number derivation shall use the source-defined BIN, partial account, check digit, and discretionary-data components when the flow requires it.

The Account Number field used for serial-number derivation shall decompose into a 6-byte BIN, a 9-byte Partial Account Number, and a 1-byte Visa modulo check digit, totaling the 16-digit Account Number.
The Track II Start Sentinel and End Sentinel characters shall be cut from the packet and shall not appear in the data transmitted to the host application.
The Track II PVKI field is not currently used by the First Data Premium Gift Card system and shall not be validated as a meaningful business value.

testCases.positive: Valid Premium Gift Card Track II structure with sentinels excluded from the transmitted packet
negative: Start/End Sentinel present in transmitted data

testCases.positive: Serial number derives from 6-byte BIN + 9-byte partial account + 1-byte check digit
